title.narrative: Increased capacity of Member States to promote decent employment for youth

description.narrative:
The following are the major global deliverables and activities of the ILO in this policy area: (1) Advisory tools and training packages to support the implementation and monitoring of integrated youth employment programmes, delivery of capacity building in collaboration with the Turin Centre and ILO–CINTERFOR, and knowledge exchange through a number of events (including Academies, Forums and Conferences).
(2) Knowledge products on youth employment, employability, skills and other relevant topics. Development of technical notes, policy briefs, reports (including the GET Youth) and research to inform the integrated approach to youth employment.
(3) Promote inclusive social dialogue with and for youth in collaboration with social partners and undertake campaigns for youth participation and youth rights at work.
(4) Promote and leverage global partnerships through the Global Initiative on Decent Jobs for Youth and the Global Accelerator on Jobs and Social Protection for Just Transitions to promote integrated solutions to assist the transition of young people in the labour market and provide a platform for knowledge sharing (through the YouthForsight Knowledge Facility).
